Topic.label: The Geometric Meaning of k in Inverse Proportional Functions

Question: Point \(P\) lies on the graph of the inverse proportional function \(y=-8/x\). \(PA\) is perpendicular to the \(x\)-axis at \(A\), and \(PB\) is perpendicular to the \(y\)-axis at \(B\). Find the area of rectangle \(OAPB\).
Solution: The area of the rectangle equals the product of the absolute values of the coordinates of \(P\), namely \(|k|=|-8|=8\).
